explanation.headline: Oseltamivir phosphate is not on FDA's shortage list today; three Corvale sites hold 15 to 20 days on hand and the preferred label names a plant not yet placed

sentences.text: Corvale East holds 564 units at 29.4 per day for 19 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 639 units at 32.3 per day for 20 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 47 units at 3.2 per day for 15 days on hand.
The label for NDC 64380079801 names Strides Pharma Science Limited Bengaluru - 562106 as the manufacturing plant, but that plant has not been placed in our records.
An alternative label for NDC 68788406601 names Preferred Pharmaceuticals Inc. (FEI 3004582966) as a registered relabeling plant with a VAI inspection on 2025-05-27.
Check whether the Strides plant can be placed and confirm allocation from A-S Medication Solutions to cover the 15 to 20 day range across sites.

rejected.text: FDA's shortage list does not include oseltamivir phosphate as of 2026-10-21.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-a0cd4d.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%oseltamivir%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%oseltamivir%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-1f506d.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('f26154bd-374c-44a8-983a-b2724a591653', '9dac3ba2-b667-4081-9395-8db45d38ceac') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-40abe4.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%oseltamivir%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-fd9b3c.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%oseltamivir%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-998da2.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%oseltamivir%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%capsule%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-692491.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3004582966') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-210c61.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3004582966') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-44443e.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3004582966') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('preferred', 'strides science bengaluru 562106')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-961042.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('preferred', 'strides science bengaluru 562106', 'strides science') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%oseltamivir%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-f8014e.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('64380079801', '68788406601')

Q-409201.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%oseltamivir%'
